title: Three-dimensional retinal organoids from mouse pluripotent stem cells mimic in vivo development with enhanced stratification and rod photoreceptor differentiation
markdown:
## Protocol: Retinal Differentiation of Mouse Embryonic Stem Cells

### Overview

This protocol outlines the generation, maintenance, and retinal differentiation of mouse embryonic stem cells (ESCs) and induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) derived from Nrl-GFP transgenic mice. The process involves isolating ESCs from blastocysts, generating iPSCs via lentiviral reprogramming, maintaining cells in feeder-dependent conditions with LIF and 3i, and differentiating them into 3D neural retinas using a modified SFEBq protocol under hypoxic conditions followed by maturation with taurine and retinoic acid.

### Materials/Reagents

- Nrl-GFP transgenic mouse embryos (3.5-day blastocysts, E14.5 MEFs)
- Mouse embryonic fibroblast (MEF) feeder cells
- Knockout Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM; Life Technologies, Cat# 11995073)
- Eagle's minimum essential medium (MEM) non-essential amino acids (Sigma, Cat# M7145)
- GlutaMAX (Life Technologies)
- Penicillin-streptomycin (PS; Life Technologies)
- β-mercaptoethanol (Life Technologies)
- Leukemia Inhibitory Factor (LIF; Millipore, Darmstadt, Germany)
- Embryonic stem cell-qualified fetal bovine serum (FBS; Life Technologies)
- DMEM/Nutrient Mixture F-12 (F12) with GlutaMAX (Life Technologies, Cat# 10565042)
- N2 supplement (Life Technologies)
- B27 supplement (Life Technologies)
- DPBS (Dulbecco's phosphate-buffered saline; Life Technologies, Cat# 14190250)
- Triton X-100 (Sigma)
- TrypLE Express (Life Technologies)
- Retinoic acid (RA; Sigma)
- Taurine

### Equipment

- 100 mm poly-HEMA-coated Petri dishes (Sigma)
- Hypoxia incubator capable of 5% O2 and 20% O2

### Safety & Sterility

Maintain sterile conditions throughout all cell culture steps. Use DPBS for washing. Ensure proper handling of viral vectors during iPSC generation.

## Reagent Preparation

### Preparation

1. Maintain Nrl-GFP ESCs and iPSCs on feeder cells in knockout DMEM supplemented with 1X MEM non-essential amino acids, 1X GlutaMAX, 1X penicillin-streptomycin, 1× β-mercaptoethanol, 2,000 U/ml Leukemia Inhibitory Factor (LIF), and 15% embryonic stem cell-qualified FBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->
2. Supply retinal organoids with DMEM/F12 with GlutaMAX supplemented with 2% FBS, 1X penicillin-streptomycin, 1X MEM non-essential amino acids, 1X N2 supplement, and 1X B27 supplement; add 1X β-mercaptoethanol to all media every time. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S02 -->
3. Transfer 72 retinal organoids at Day 7 (D7) to a 100 mm poly-HEMA-coated Petri dish containing 10 ml retinal maturation medium (DMEM/F12 with GlutaMAX with 1X PS). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S03 -->
4. After 48 hours, wash the cells once with DPBS (containing 2.6 mM KCl, 1.47 mM KH2PO4, 137.93 mM NaCl, 8.06 mM Na2HPO4-7H2O, pH 7.0-7.3). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S04 -->
5. Wash the cells three times with DPBS and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature in blocking solution containing DPBS with 10% FBS and 0.2% Triton X-100. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S05 -->

## Differentiation into 3D Neural Retinas

### D0 to D10

1. Differentiate ESCs and iPSCs (passages 15-25) using the SFEBq protocol with modifications: apply hypoxic conditions from D0 to D10. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S01 -->
2. Transfer 72 retinal organoids at D7 to a 100 mm poly-HEMA-coated Petri dish with 10 ml retinal maturation medium (DMEM/F12 with GlutaMAX with 1X PS). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S02 -->
3. Change the maturation medium of the retinal cultures at D10 and add 1 mM taurine and 500 nM retinoic acid (RA). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S03 -->

### from D10 onward

1. Incubate cultures at 5% O2 from D0 to D10 and switch to 20% O2 from D10 onward. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S01 -->

### D14

1. At D14, change half of the media and reduce the culture density to 36 organoids per 100 mm dish. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S01 -->
2. Culture 36 uncut retinal organoids in a 100 mm poly-HEMA-coated dish after D14. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S02 -->

### D14 to D26

1. Add retinoic acid (RA) to the culture from D14 to D26. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T3-S01 -->
2. Maintain cultures until D26, changing half of the media every 3 days. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T3-S02 -->

### D26

1. At D26, replace full media with DMEM/F12 containing GlutaMAX supplemented with 2% FBS, 1X PS, 1X NEAA, 1X N2, and 1X B27. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T4-S01 -->
2. Half of the media was then changed every 2 days. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T4-S02 -->

## ESC and iPSC Generation and Maintenance

### 3.5-day blastocysts

1. Isolate ESC clones from the inner cell mass (ICM) of 3.5-day blastocysts of Nrl-GFP transgenic mice on mouse embryonic fibroblast (MEF) feeders in the presence of LIF and 3i. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S01 -->

### Generation

1. Generate iPSC clones by infecting E14.5 MEFs from Nrl-GFP mice with Dox-inducible lentiviral vectors carrying Oct3/4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc genes individually, then culture on MEF feeder cells for 3 weeks. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S01 -->

### Post-Generation

1. Pick embryonic stem cell-like colonies and transfer them onto fresh feeder cells; evaluate quality by morphology, proliferation rate, and Nanog expression. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S01 -->
2. Maintain Nrl-GFP ESCs and iPSCs on feeder cells in knockout DMEM supplemented with 1X MEM non-essential amino acids, 1X GlutaMAX, 1X penicillin-streptomycin, 1× β-mercaptoethanol, 2,000 U/ml LIF, and 15% embryonic stem cell-qualified FBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S02 -->
3. Passage cells using TrypLE Express. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S03 -->
